questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: An electromagnetic wave propagating in vacuum in [Electromagnetic Waves] has an electric field amplitude $E_0 = 120\text{ V/m}$. What is the radiation pressure exerted by this beam when it is completely absorbed upon normal incidence on a surface?
questions.solution: Average energy density is $u_{avg} = \frac{1}{2}\varepsilon_0 E_0^2$. Radiation pressure on complete absorption is $P_{rad} = u_{avg} = \frac{1}{2}\varepsilon_0 E_0^2$.
questions.explanation: Analyze the physical model and equations in Electromagnetic Waves.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: One mole of ideal gas undergoes a polytropic expansion $P V^2 = C$ in [Electromagnetic Waves] from volume $V_0 = 1\text{ m}^3$ at pressure $P_0 = 10^5\text{ Pa}$ to $V_1 = 2\text{ m}^3$. Calculate the magnitude of work done by the gas in $\text{kJ}$ rounded to nearest integer.
questions.solution: Work done in polytropic process with $n=2$: $W = \frac{P_0 V_0 - P_1 V_1}{n - 1} = P_0 V_0 \left(1 - \frac{V_0}{V_1}\right) = 10^5 \times 1 \times (1 - 0.5) = 5 \times 10^4\text{ J} = 50\text{ kJ}$.
questions.explanation: Calculate using quantitative physical laws in Electromagnetic Waves.
